about: St. Clements is a rural municipality in Manitoba’s Interlake east of the Red River, northeast of Winnipeg—not a city. East Selkirk, Libau, and Grand Marais–area approaches share lake, marsh, and farm country toward Lake Winnipeg. About 12,000 people live in St. Clements RM.
